description: WELCOME TO A UNIQUE PLACE, A TYPICAL PAVILION IN THE HEART OF PARIS, a few steps from the Champs-Élysées, the most beautiful Avenue in the World and the Georges V metro.The location is perfect for visiting PARIS center on foot or by metro, no need for a car. Between 10 or 15 minutes from all centers of interest: Eiffel Tower, museums, Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Latin Quarter, Montmartre,…All shops are accessible directly within a few steps of the accommodation.The spaceVery quiet, located in a charming, typically Parisian paved interior courtyard, the pavilion is a haven of peace in the middle of the city, without the inconvenience of street noise.An entire pavilion on 2 levels, (Ground Floor, 1st floor) with interior elevator and air conditioning.Redesigned by an architect and a decorator, the Pavillon Ponthieu has rooms which all have a bathroom, a television and a wardrobe. The materials and furniture are of high quality to offer you a comfortable stay.Fully automated, the Pavillon Ponthieu has exclusive access for you. High-speed Internet, televisions in each room, air conditioning.In the entrance hall you have a secure SAS, to drop off your luggage if you arrive early, or leave after 10 AM.Accommodation is for 8 people - 4 bedrooms / 5 beds- 2 bedrooms with quality queen size beds, private shower room with Japanese WC- 1 bedroom with quality double bed, private shower room- 1 bedroom with 2 beds (bunk beds).- 4 private bathrooms, 2 of which have their own WC.- 3 "Japanese" WCs, for optimal hygiene.- Accessible to people with reduced mobility (wheelchairs).-------------GROUND FLOOR1.
